text:
priya: Heads-up 1: we need a clear contract for surfacing routing + quota signals to clients. Proposal: keep programmatic decisions in the body, provide lightweight headers for SDKs/console, and an optional short copy for UIs. Want quick alignment so the SDK teams can implement before next release.

tom: Sounds good. Can you show an example payload + headers you'd surface?

priya: Example we discussed: 

```
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
X-Redwood-Routing: reserved
X-Redwood-Quota-Reason: tenant_limit_reached
X-Redwood-Quota-Window: 2026-03-21T12:00:00Z/2026-03-21T13:00:00Z
X-Redwood-UI-Hint: "You've reached your hourly usage limit"
```

Body (canonical):
```
{
  "error": "quota_exhausted",
  "code": "rate.quota.tenant.limit",
  "quota_type": "hard",
  "retry_after_seconds": 3600
}
```

priya: Notes: headers are optional, should be ignored if unknown. Body is the source of truth for SDK behavior.

liam: Important: SDKs need to know retryable vs non-retryable. `quota_type` solves that. Also require a numeric subcode in body (we'll keep `code` as string but SDKs may parse a registry mapping to linear integers).

tom: UX: please don't show `tenant_limit_reached` to end-users. Map to friendlier copy in SDKs or UI components. The `X-Redwood-UI-Hint` should be the canonical user copy if present. Otherwise SDKs render a friendly fallback.

mike: Rollout plan: feature-flag the headers+UI hint for a small canary (5 customers) and enable the console badge that shows the active quota window + friendly text. Add a metric `ui_hint_present` and `ui_hint_rendered`.

ops-bot: canary-rollout/start flagged:quota-ui-hint canary-group=alpha target=5 at 2026-03-21T12:05:10Z

eva: Telemetry: add `routing_tier` and `quota_reason` as tags on request spans and counters. Console should show last 24h history of quota reasons for the tenant. Also add an alert if any canary org reports >0.5% JSON parse errors.

liam: Edge case: some customers proxy responses and strip unknown headers. We must ensure SDKs don't rely solely on headers. Body-first rule is required. Also add a server-side header `X-Redwood-Proto-Version` so SDKs can detect contract version.

priya: Updated contract (short):
- Body: canonical error object with `code`, `quota_type`, `retry_after_seconds`, optional `subcode_id`
- Headers: `X-Redwood-Routing`, `X-Redwood-Quota-Reason`, `X-Redwood-Quota-Window`, optional `X-Redwood-UI-Hint`, `X-Redwood-Proto-Version`
- SDKs: prefer body for logic, use `X-Redwood-UI-Hint` for display when present. Map internal codes -> friendly messages.

mike: Canary ops: pick 5 non-critical orgs, observe 48h. If `ui_hint_rendered` > 90% of cases where header present and error-free, expand to 25 orgs. Watch for any spike in client-side errors.

tom: I'll prepare a small mapping table and code snippets for JS/Python SDKs showing how to fallback from header -> body -> default string.

liam: I'll add handling in retry-decider to treat `quota_type: "burst"` as retryable with exponential backoff and `"hard"` as not retryable until tenant updates quota. Will include unit tests.

eva: I'll add the telemetry tags and the alert rule for parse errors, plus a dashboard panel for "Quota UI hits" and "Quota reasons by tenant".

priya: Action owners: tom (SDK mapping + snippets), liam (retry logic + tests), eva (telemetry + alert + panel), mike (canary list + console badge text), priya (RFC + runbook link). I'll post the RFC in 1h.

mike: One more ask: console copy should include a one-click link to open a support/ops ticket template pre-filled with the quota window and reason. Makes it easier for customers to escalate.

priya: Good idea. Add to the RFC. Thanks everyone. We'll reconvene after the canary metric sweep. :party_parrot:
